headline: Baseus’ new security camera has a spotlight that tracks and follows moving targets
summary: Baseus unveiled a new AI-assisted security camera. It features a motorized spotlight that actively tracks intruders. The camera aims to proactively deter unwanted visitors.

headline: Elon Musk’s proposed SpaceX stock giveaway would go into ‘Trump Accounts’
summary: Elon Musk plans to give one SpaceX share to "every kid in America." President Trump announced these shares will be distributed via "Trump Accounts." Musk thanked Brad Gerstner for enabling this initiative.

headline: The fossil fuel comeback is here
summary: The US is building fossil fuel infrastructure at a decade-high pace. Renewable energy growth is slowing, despite rising electricity demand. Increased demand comes from data centers, factories, and EVs.

headline: CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
summary: CoreWeave's bonds recently entered distressed territory. Investors are demanding significantly higher yields on their debt. This raises concerns about a potential private credit bubble in the AI sector.

headline: There's Real Force Behind These Star Wars Battlefront 3 Rumors
summary: Rumors for Star Wars Battlefront 3 have intensified recently. Multiple studios are reportedly being considered for development. Excitement builds for a potential new installment in the shooter series.

headline: Save $40 Off Microsoft's Professional-Grade Xbox Elite Series 2 Core Wireless Controller
summary: Get $40 off the Xbox Elite Series 2 Core Wireless Controller. This professional-grade controller offers a premium gaming experience. The deal presents a worthy upgrade for serious gamers.

headline: Disney Will Air a Real-Time, Animated Version of the 2027 Super Bowl Set in the Star Wars Universe
summary: Disney plans an animated, real-time Super Bowl broadcast in 2027. The unique event will be set within the Star Wars universe. This innovative broadcast merges sports and iconic sci-fi.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Pop-Up: The DMZ Has Never Been This Much Fun
summary: A Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 pop-up event is generating buzz. Players are praising the DMZ mode as exceptionally fun. The event highlights an exciting experience for fans.

headline: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
summary: The Chancellor has dismissed proposals to increase Capital Gains Tax. Labour figures advocated equalizing CGT with income tax. Critics warned a hike could lead to wealthy individuals leaving Britain.

headline: How the attack on an Australian MP unfolded
summary: A BBC reporter visits Wangaratta to cover an attack on an Australian MP. The community held a vigil at a local church. The report details the unfolding of the incident.

headline: We asked teens what schools should teach them about work. This is what they said
summary: Teenagers desire more work experience opportunities in school. They also seek improved communication skills training. The report highlights youth perspectives on preparing for the workforce.

headline: Criminals detained in hospital set to lose benefits
summary: Criminals detained in hospitals will now lose their benefits. This change follows a campaign by Nottingham killer Valdo Calocane's victims' families. The measure addresses concerns raised by those affected by serious crimes.
